item.title: Vivere con l'iperacusia: un disturbo poco conosciuto
item.description:

item.title: HIIT helps older adults lose fat while preserving muscle
item.description:
A study of adults in their 70s found that high-intensity interval training (HIIT) reduces body fat while maintaining lean muscle mass. Other exercise intensities led to fat loss but failed to preserve muscle as effectively.

item.description:

item.title: Pesticide exposure linked to doubled Parkinson’s disease risk
item.description:
UCLA scientists found that long-term exposure to the pesticide chlorpyrifos significantly increases Parkinson’s disease risk. The chemical damages dopamine neurons and prevents the brain from removing toxic protein buildup.
